title: PRD: Incremental hosted surface (slim bundle) + launch & cutover checklist
creator: Priya Nair
description: This PRD defines a slim, incremental hosted API surface that combines chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank into a lightweight bundle intended for early adopters and low-latency use cases. The goal is to ship a minimal, backwards-compatible endpoint map + SDK ergonomics that allows gradual traffic migration from legacy endpoints while keeping operational and cost controls tight. This doc covers scope, acceptance criteria, QA, rollout plan, SLOs, and cutover checklist for a staged production launch.
scope_inclusions: Single endpoint alias: /v1/hosted/slim with mode param (chat|complete|embed|rerank)
Default behavioral contract aligned to existing hosted endpoints (same prompt/response shape where possible)
Lightweight SDK helpers for quick adoption (JavaScript + Python minimal wrappers)
Telemetry hooks: per-request model, token usage, lane, latency, error code
Canary + progressive rollout hooks in Console: per-tenant toggle and percent rollout
scope_exclusions: No multi-model composition or orchestrations in v1
No advanced function/tool calling in initial release
No dedicated tenant-level burst autoscaling controls (will use existing infra policies)
acceptance_criteria: API contract stability: 99% response schema parity for chat/completions compared to canonical endpoints
Performance: p95 end-to-end latency <= 200ms for common small prompt profiles in region-us-west-2
Cost: per-token cost profile documented and within 10% of forecast for expected batching profiles
Reliability: error rate <= 0.5% for steady-state traffic during 1K RPS synthetic load
SDKs: JS and Python wrappers published, examples and quickstart verified by DX team
Telemetry: token-level cost, model variant, lane, and region surfaced in Console dashboards and traceable in logs
Rollout controls: Console toggle can route 0/1/10/25/50/100% traffic and auto-fallback to legacy endpoints on defined error thresholds
Security: passing SSO/KMS integration smoke test for private tenant with sample keys
launch_checklist: [PRD REVIEW] PM/Eng/Design sign-off on behavioral contract and sample payloads
[API CONTRACT] OpenAPI spec published + changelog; compatibility notes for breaking vs non-breaking changes
[SDK] JS/Python packages released to internal registry and documentation hosted
[EVALS] Eval harness run: toxicity, hallucination, answer coherence for chat/completions; similarity quality for embeddings; top-k stability for rerank
[PERF] Load tests: 1K/5K/10K simulated RPS runs and autoscaling sanity validated
[OBSERVABILITY] Dashboards created: token-cost, p50/p95/p99 latency by region/model/lane, error taxonomy
[OPERATIONS] Runbook & rollback playbook uploaded to Console knowledge base
[SECURITY] KMS integration smoke & audit log verification
[SUPPORT] Incident runbook drill scheduled with on-call rotation and war room template
[LEGAL] Data handling statement updated for hosted-slim bundle in privacy docs
[COMM] Release notes and migration guide drafted for customers and internal docs
[CANARY] Canary plan scheduled with target tenant slices and success metrics
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal dogfood (1 week) -> Phase 1: Opt-in early adopters (10% low-risk tenants, 2 weeks) -> Phase 2: Broad canary (25% traffic, 1 week) -> Phase 3: Regional ramp (50% per region, monitoring 72h) -> Phase 4: Full cutover with rollback gates. Automatic fallback to legacy endpoints if error rate or latency breaches thresholds defined in rollout gates.
telemetry_and_slo: SLOs: availability 99.95% monthly, p95 latency <= 200ms for small prompts, error budget policy documented
Telemetry: token_counter, request_size, model_variant, lane, queue_time, gpu_utilization per host
Alerting: high error rate (>0.5% sustained for 5m), p95 latency spike (>2x baseline), token-usage anomalies (>25% week-over-week)
api_contract_changes: Add: /v1/hosted/slim with body {mode, inputs, params, context_kv} — mode determines surface behavior
Mapping: 'chat' -> streaming vs non-streaming parity, 'embed' -> embeddings vector response, 'rerank' -> scores array
Fallback: if unknown 'mode', return 400 with guidance; if model unsupported, return 503 with suggested model variants
Versioning: initial release is v1; any breaking contract changes must increment major version and follow deprecation timeline
sdk_impacts: JS: add helper createSlimClient + example wrappers for chat/complete/embed/rerank
Python: slim_client convenience class with context manager and async support
Docs: quickstart migration snippets to convert existing hosted endpoint calls to slim bundle
Telemetry: SDK attaches token and lane metadata automatically when available
qa_test_plan: Functional: validate response shapes across 100 canonical prompts for each mode
Regression: run regression suite against legacy endpoints for parity metrics
Load: stress tests at 3X expected peak for autoscaling and error handling
Chaos: inject network errors and Redis/KV timeouts to validate graceful degradation
Security: pen test for API auth and KMS access patterns (light smoke)
notes_and_decisions: Decision: Use a single alias endpoint to reduce cognitive overhead for new customers; mode param selected after trade-off analysis
Trade-off: delaying advanced function-calling reduces scope and accelerates launch; plan to iterate in v1.1
Ops constraint: to hit p95 latency target we will restrict default batch window to 10ms and enable aggressive KV prefix caching
risks: Model behavior drift when routing different workloads through a single surface
Compatibility surprises for existing customers expecting legacy endpoint semantics
Telemetry sampling may miss short-lived regressions if sampling thresholds are too high
